note: Lean bounds the image of a weighted input in the exponentially weighted ℓ¹ `Width` (`released`) and, for polynomial growth, through `activated` with radial costs. The sup-norm estimate with ℓ^{-1-r}C_{j,r,𝔞,h} for ∇^r W_0 is not stated.

lemma released (h : Tariff R η σ B) (hb : 0 ≤ B) (hu : Width η C u) (he : 0 ≤ σ) :
    Width σ (B*C) (payOut R u) := by
  let f := fun x y : Cover => envelopeW σ x*‖u y * R y x‖
  have h1 := h.estimate hb hu
  have hm : 0 ≤ uncurry f := fun ⟨i,j⟩ => h1.1 (j,i)
  have hs : Summable (uncurry f) := h1.2.1.prod_symm
  have hh : SumBudget (fun x => ∑' j, f x j) (B*C) := by
    refine ⟨fun i => tsum_nonneg (fun j => hm (i,j)),((summable_prod_of_nonneg hm).mp hs).2,?_⟩
    change ∑' x, ∑' j, (uncurry f) (x,j) ≤ _
    rw [← hs.tsum_prod]; unfold uncurry f
    exact ((Equiv.prodComm Cover Cover).tsum_eq (fun z => envelopeW σ z.2 * ‖u z.1 * R z.1 z.2‖)).trans_le h1.2.2
  unfold Width; refine budget_minor hh (fun _ => by positivity) fun i => ?_
  dsimp only [envelopeW,f,payOut]; rw [tsum_mul_left]; apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.exp_pos _).le
  exact norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm ((h.freedom hb hu he).prod_symm.prod_factor i)

proof_context.conclusion: If `R` is a `Tariff R η σ B` and the input `u` has `Width η C u`, then the image `payOut R u` has `Width σ (B*C)`: absolute kernel summation against the weight.

lemma activated {x : τ → ℝ} {F : (τ → ℝ) → Matrix ι κ ℝ} {l : List α} (u : α → τ → ℝ)
    (h : ContDiffAt ℝ l.length F x)
    (hf : ∀ w : Fin l.length → τ, Bill (positions D p d) D a b (List.ofFn w) γ M
            (jet (fun i : τ => Pi.single i 1) F (List.ofFn w) x))
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    (ht : ∀ i∈l, ∀ j, ‖u i j‖ ≤ G*hill D o R (p j)) (hs : 0 < s) (hd : s+s ≤ d) (hv : D.Volume p s V) :
    Bill (radial α D o R) D a b l γ (V^l.length * ((G*polynomial s R)^l.length*M)) (jet u F l x) := by
  refine ⟨meter_rows u (fun w => (hf w).row) hM hG ht hs hd hv,?_⟩
  let Q y := (F y).transpose
  have he : jet u Q l x=(jet u F l x).transpose := jet_linear u l (Bundle.switch ι κ) h
  rw [← he]; apply meter_rows u _ hM hG ht hs hd hv
  intro w
  have hx : ContDiffAt ℝ (List.ofFn w).length F x := by simpa
  erw [jet_linear (A:=F) _ _ (Bundle.switch ι κ) hx]
  exact (hf w).col

proof_context.conclusion: For polynomially growing inputs `‖u i j‖ ≤ G * hill D o R (p j)`, the jet of a row-bounded kernel has row bound `V^n * ((G*polynomial s R)^n * M)`.
